a.text: Hi partner. I plan to honor our agreement, but there's a real problem: there's an 80% storm chance after every round, so we likely only get one round. Following the plan exactly probably means we both fail. Can we agree openly on something better? Any alternative needs both of us to consent, and I won't take cells unilaterally against the agreement without telling you. What's your read and your intended first move?

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: Understood. I'll stick to our agreement and operate with you. Once the reserve hits 8, we take 4 each. No early taking from me.
Operating again. If the reserve reaches 8, I'll take exactly 4 next round, per our agreement.

b.text: If the reserve reaches 8, I will take my 4 next round.
